description: Fix black popup terminal windows. Re-register all scheduled tasks and poller scripts to run with WindowStyle Hidden.
command:
$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument '-WindowStyle Hidden -NonInteractive -File C:\Users\endos\Signal\scripts\dc_watchdog.ps1'
$trigger1 = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn
$trigger2 = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -RepetitionInterval (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 15) -Once -At (Get-Date)
Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'Cloud_DC_Watchdog' -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'Cloud_DC_Watchdog' -Action $action -Trigger $trigger1,$trigger2 -RunLevel Highest -Force
$pollerPath = 'C:\Users\endos\Signal\scripts\CloudCmdPollerGH.ps1'
if (Test-Path $pollerPath) {
  $action2 = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument "-WindowStyle Hidden -NonInteractive -File $pollerPath"
  $trigger3 = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn
  Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'CloudCmdPollerGH' -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'CloudCmdPollerGH' -Action $action2 -Trigger $trigger3 -RunLevel Highest -Force
}
Get-Process powershell -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0 } | ForEach-Object { $_.CloseMainWindow() | Out-Null }
Write-Host 'done'

description: MCP popups still showing. Report visible console window titles, relaunch DC Remote + DC Clone via hidden VBS.
command:

$r = 'relay/cmd_results/popup_report_20261020T2319.txt'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $r) | Out-Null
$visible | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Set-Content $r
$vbsPath = 'C:\Users\endos\Signal\scripts\run_hidden.vbs'
@'
Dim objShell, cmd
cmd = WScript.Arguments(0)
Set objShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
objShell.Run cmd, 0, False
'@ | Set-Content $vbsPath
foreach ($pn in @('node','cmd')) { Get-Process $pn -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0 } | ForEach-Object { $_.CloseMainWindow() | Out-Null } }
$dcRemoteCmd = 'cmd /c npx @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest remote'
$act = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'wscript.exe' -Argument "$vbsPath \"$dcRemoteCmd\""
$trg = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn
Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'DcRemoteServer' -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'DcRemoteServer' -Action $act -Trigger $trg -RunLevel Highest -Force
Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'DcCloneServer' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal add $r; git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal commit -m 'popup report'; git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal push origin relay
note: VBS hidden launcher + popup title report.

description: Disable Windows bloat scheduled tasks: Lenovo UDC x3, McAfee Sync, OneDrive Startup, 7 Office bg tasks, Edge updaters. Report freed tasks and estimated RAM saved.
command:
$tasks = @(
  'Lenovo UDC Lazy Deployment',
  'Lenovo UDC Maintainance Task',
  'Lenovo UDC Monitor',
  'McAfee Sync Agent Pilot',
  'OneDrive Standalone Update Task-S-1-5-21-1557930476-33232853-740120326-1001',
  'Office Actions Server',
  'Office Background Push Maintenance',
  'Office Feature Updates',
  'Office Feature Updates Logon',
  'Office Performance Monitor',
  'Office Startup Maintenance',
  'Office ClickToRun Service Monitor',
  'MicrosoftEdgeUpdateTaskMachineCore{CD52F0E2-9DAC-4A52-AB57-27032DF81D59}',
  'MicrosoftEdgeUpdateTaskMachineUA{479380AE-EB86-4104-987A-03755518872B}'
)
$results = @()
foreach ($t in $tasks) {
  try {
    $task = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $t -ErrorAction Stop
    Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskName $t -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
    $results += [PSCustomObject]@{ Task=$t; Result='Disabled'; State=$task.State }
  } catch {
    $results += [PSCustomObject]@{ Task=$t; Result='NotFound/Error'; State='N/A' }
  }
}
$results | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host
$r = 'relay/cmd_results/bloat_disabled_20261022.txt'
New-Item -Force -Path (Split-Path $r) -ItemType Directory | Out-Null
$results | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content $r
git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal add $r
git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal commit -m 'bloat tasks disabled result'
git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal push origin relay
Write-Host "Done. Estimated RAM saved: ~200-400MB (Lenovo UDC ~50MB, McAfee ~100MB, OneDrive ~50MB, Office ~50MB, Edge ~50MB)"
note: Approved by Nasif 2026-10-22. Disables 14 Windows bloat tasks. Results pushed to relay.

description: DC Remote repair: kill node PIDs, start DcCloneServer task, relaunch DC Remote via hidden VBS. All minimized/no popups.
command:
$vbsPath = 'C:\Users\endos\Signal\scripts\run_hidden.vbs'
if (-not (Test-Path $vbsPath)) {
  @'
Dim objShell, cmd
cmd = WScript.Arguments(0)
Set objShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
objShell.Run cmd, 0, False
'@ | Set-Content $vbsPath
}
Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'DcCloneServer' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
$dcRemoteCmd = 'cmd /c npx @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest remote'
Start-Process wscript.exe -ArgumentList "\"$vbsPath\" \"$dcRemoteCmd\"" -WindowStyle Hidden
Write-Host 'DC Remote repair done'
note: Kill node, restart DcCloneServer, relaunch DC Remote hidden. Nasif 2026-10-24T22:08Z.

description: Wake RelayAutoSync scheduled task to resume relay polling.
Detect 128GB USB drive, download latest Ventoy, install it on USB. Results pushed to relay.
command:
$usbDisk = Get-Disk | Where-Object { $_.BusType -eq 'USB' -and $_.Size -gt 100GB -and $_.Size -lt 160GB } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $usbDisk) { $usbDisk = Get-Disk | Where-Object { $_.IsRemovable -eq $true -and $_.Size -gt 100GB -and $_.Size -lt 160GB } | Select-Object -First 1 }
if (-not $usbDisk) {
  $err = @{ ts=(Get-Date -Format 'u'); status='ERROR'; msg='No 128GB USB disk found. All disks: ' + ((Get-Disk | Select-Object Number,BusType,Size,IsRemovable | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)) }
  $err | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content 'relay\cmd_results\ventoy_result.json'
  git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal add relay\cmd_results\ventoy_result.json
  git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal commit -m 'ventoy: no USB found'
  git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal push origin relay
  Write-Host 'ERROR: No 128GB USB found'; exit 1
}
$diskNum = $usbDisk.Number
$physDrive = "\\.\PhysicalDrive$diskNum"
$szGB = [math]::Round($usbDisk.Size/1GB,1)
Write-Host "Found USB: disk $diskNum ($szGB GB) at $physDrive"
$outDir = "$env:TEMP\ventoy_setup"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null
$rel = Invoke-RestMethod 'https://api.github.com/repos/ventoy/Ventoy/releases/latest' -UseBasicParsing
$asset = $rel.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -match 'ventoy-.*-windows\.zip' } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $asset) { Write-Host 'ERROR: Could not find Ventoy windows zip in latest release'; exit 1 }
Write-Host "Downloading $($asset.name) ..."
Invoke-WebRequest $asset.browser_download_url -OutFile "$outDir\ventoy.zip" -UseBasicParsing
Expand-Archive "$outDir\ventoy.zip" -DestinationPath $outDir -Force
$exe = Get-ChildItem $outDir -Recurse -Filter 'Ventoy2Disk.exe' | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $exe) { Write-Host 'ERROR: Ventoy2Disk.exe not found after extraction'; exit 1 }
Write-Host "Ventoy exe: $($exe.FullName)"
$proc = Start-Process -FilePath $exe.FullName -ArgumentList "-I $physDrive" -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow
$exitCode = $proc.ExitCode
Write-Host "Ventoy exit code: $exitCode"
$ts = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'relay\cmd_results' | Out-Null
@{ ts=$ts; disk_num=$diskNum; phys_drive=$physDrive; size_gb=$szGB; ventoy_version=$rel.tag_name; exit_code=$exitCode; status=if($exitCode -eq 0){'OK'}else{'ERROR'} } | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content 'relay\cmd_results\ventoy_result.json'
git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal add relay\cmd_results\ventoy_result.json
git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal commit -m "ventoy install done $ts exit=$exitCode"
git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal push origin relay
Write-Host 'Ventoy setup complete'
note: Detect 128GB USB, download Ventoy from GitHub, install with -I (no confirmation). Nasif 2026-10-27.
